digest.component_or_area: code complexity linting and ratchet verification
propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run cyclomatic complexity increased from baseline ceiling 24 to 25 due to success-path try/except added in commit aec1, causing C901 ratchet gate to fail on origin/main
Commit c9f7 added complexity ratchet verification but was verified before aec1 merged; Gerrit's submit-time rebase stacked the gate without re-verifying, exposing the baseline violation

Extract the success-path run-shape capture (usage_log.run_shape + shape_only + telemetry-safe except) into a module-level helper _merge_success_run_shape to reduce PydanticAIRunner.run complexity back to baseline ceiling
Helper must preserve in-place mutation of usage dict and behavior-preserving merge of success-path run-shape keys, as proven by existing test suite
Helper must swallow run_shape/shape_only reducer failures with warning log and leave authoritative usage dict unchanged
